title: Collapse of LiNi 1– x – y Co x Mn y O 2 Lattice at Deep Charge Irrespective of Nickel Content in Lithium-Ion Batteries

extraction_issues.quote: most notably layered LiNi13-5 A current push to higher nickel content x-yCoxMnyO2 (NCM).
extraction_issues.reason: “LiNi13-5”明显不是有效化学式，应为“LiNi1-x-yCoxMnyO2 (NCM)”的截断或乱码；且“A current push”与前文语义断裂。原文在“layered”后应接续“LiNi1-x-yCoxMnyO2 (NCM) (1-x-y ≥ 0.8)”，但提取文本出现“LiNi13-5”和“x-yCoxMnyO2”，疑似OCR或提取错误。

unverified_issue_candidates.quote: based on in situ XRD, Co-Mn co-substitution shows little, if at all, effectiveness on inhibiting the anisotropic lattice collapse of NCM cathodes at deep charge: with an extraction of roughly 80
unverified_issue_candidates.reason: 句子在第二页结尾处中断于“roughly 80”，第三页开头先出现图注“FIGURE 2.”，然后才继续“mol% Li, abrupt c-axis...”，导致句子的数值与后续内容被图注隔开，阅读顺序被打断。

self_check: 已核对摘要、正文中的关键数值：4种NCM在4.4V下容量218/195/176/163 mAh/g；80 mol%脱锂时充电电压4.49/4.81/4.94/5.01 V，容量220-222 mAh/g；80%脱锂时c轴收缩4.9%（低镍）与5.7%（高镍）；DFT计算脱锂程度为0、50、83 mol%。公式Vtot = Vionic + VHartree + Vexchange-correlation已原样保留。结论方向与摘要一致。提取文本中“LiNi13-5”疑为乱码，已标记；其余数值和符号无矛盾。未发现其他数据不一致。
